_doc: LOCKED_MODEL_CONFIG (worker_guard/model_lock.py). With MODEL_LOCK=1 every job uses exactly these model settings, so ComfyUI keeps the loaded model and never reloads it. Jobs may only change image, audio, prompt, negative prompt and frame count. Edit only together with a new measurement.

vram.max_frames_note: 2026-11-03 MODEL_LOCK test on the pod: 831 frames OK (peak 25.0 GB), 3081 frames (2 min) OOM inside the sampler before the first step (31.3 GB): the sampler cost grows with the frame count, not only the final decode. 1615 frames (61 s audio) is the longest job that ran without an OOM, so longer jobs are refused before queueing; the backend splits long audio into <= 60 s chunks that run one after another on the same worker.
vram.measured: 2026-11-03, pod b98p0yq88j1lel, RTX 5090 31.4 GB, v32, 854x480, blocks_to_swap 0, force_offload false, compile on: 1615 frames (22 windows), watchdog peak 22.4 GB during sampling, stage peak 25.9 GB (83%) = 5.5 GB headroom. blocks_to_swap 0 is the lowest value, so it is locked. decode_gb_per_frame = (25.9 - 22.4) / 1615, a one-point linear estimate of the final VAE decode: re-measure with a 2 min job.
